_comment: The pinned run config for Day-to-Day Bench task set v1. Effort is low for all seven benchmarked models, and the lowest value each judge candidate accepts (none on gpt-6.1-terra and gpt-6-luna, low elsewhere). Model ids, API versions and prices were re-read on the makers' pages on 15 November 2026 and all matched. temperature is the value in effect (1, the default) and is not sent. A config never holds a key: key_names lists entry names in the owner's key file, not values.
approved_by: Kol (repo owner): typed go for the paid runs in the AI Resource Hub session on 15 November 2026, caps 90 USD OpenAI and 60 USD Anthropic

_judge_candidates_comment: The qualify stage tries every candidate against the frozen samples, cheapest first, and names the panel: on each side the cheapest candidate that passed. Then set judges to that panel. A judge verdict is a small JSON object, so every judge and candidate has an output limit of 400 tokens.
